summary: Join our course focused on gender equity in development projects. Learn strategies to foster equality and make a positive impact in your community.
lede: Gender equity training supports development project managers, gender advisers, monitoring specialists and safeguarding leads working to address unequal project outcomes. It builds practical skills in gender and intersectional analysis, inclusive project planning and budgeting, and tracking results with disaggregated indicators. Participants also consider safeguarding and meaningful participation when making project decisions and reporting outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence development project design, implementation, evidence, safeguards, financing, or accountability and need practical gender equity capabilities at intermediate to advanced level.
modules: Gender Equity Foundations and Project Context
Inclusive Project Design and Theories of Change
Gender Data, Indicators, and Digital Monitoring
Gender Equity Integration and Action Roadmap
prerequisites: You should have working experience in development projects, programme management, monitoring and evaluation, safeguarding, gender advising, grants, or project finance. Familiarity with a logical framework, theory of change, project budget, or monitoring plan will help. No programming is required. Spreadsheet use is helpful for the data and budgeting exercises, while KoboToolbox workflows and AI-assisted qualitative analysis are taught at an operational and oversight level rather than a technical engineering level.
